function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies customer identity against record using last 4 digits of PAN or birth year before revealing any debt details. Must be called before any debt-related information is disclosed.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

verification_code.description: The 4-digit PAN code or 4-digit birth year provided by the user.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Logs the agreed promise-to-pay date and amount committed by the customer. Only call this after the customer has explicitly agreed to a payment date.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

ptp_date.description: The ISO-8601 date agreed upon for payment, e.g., 2026-08-14

amount.description: The amount the customer agreed to pay, in INR.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Triggers an instant payment link via SMS or WhatsApp to the customer's registered mobile number. Call this immediately after log_promise_to_pay succeeds.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

channel.description: Delivery channel for the payment link.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Routes the call/case to a human agent for hardship negotiation or dispute resolution that is outside the bot's authorization.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the final call outcome and disposition status in the database. Must be called exactly once before the call ends (except when superseded by a DO_NOT_CALL request, which also uses this tool).

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

status.description: Final disposition status for the call.

notes.description: Free-text notes providing context for the disposition.
